symptom: Continue after a merged PR failed with "Continue on a new branch changes Design territory while this workspace has a live uncommitted Design draft" whenever main had changed any Design file, even ones the draft did not touch.
rule: Carry uncommitted work through Git's own per-path checks plus a three-way merge of overlapping tracked edits; guard only ignored drafts and files at paths the target adds, and test the switch in a sparse checkout too (zstack-verify gotchas).
